question_record.context: A suspicious access to the LSASS service was observed on 2024-07-04 at 22:35:00.569686+00:00, where attackers were potentially trying to decrypt user's passwords from the LSASS service's memory to use in lateral movement activities. After this, there was a lateral movement activity detected involving PSExec to the jump server on 2024-07-10 at 11:24:45.260113+00:00. Moreover, a ransomware payload was remotely launched on 2024-07-04 at 22:35:02.812470+00:00, indicating potential encryption of the device's contents. Subsequently, suspicious 'GenRansom' behavior was detected on 2024-07-04 at 22:35:03.581041+00:00, indicating active malware with potential persistence mechanisms in place.
question_record.question: What is the hostname of the device where the suspicious 'GenRansom' behavior was detected?
solution: There was a suspicious access to the LSASS service involving the user with Sid `S-5-7-21-1843151660-3234030288-105586167-1422` on `2024-07-04T22:35:00.569686+00:00`.
Lateral movement to the jump server with IP address `99.83.111.100` was detected on `2024-07-10T11:24:45.260113+00:00`.
A ransomware payload was remotely launched on a device with AadDeviceId `e5799261-6720-4297-961e-bd9ca4275033` on `2024-07-04T22:35:02.812470+00:00`.
Suspicious 'GenRansom' behavior was detected on the host `vnevado-win11t` on `2024-07-04T22:35:03.581041+00:00`.

15.name: Suspicious access to LSASS service
15.description: In order to obtain clear-text password, attackers must decrypt the user's password from the LSASS service's memory. Multiple public tools as well as custom ones could be used to perform this operation. Once obtained, these credentials are often used in lateral movement activities to infiltrate other machines and servers in the network.

148.name: Suspicious 'GenRansom' behavior was detected
148.description:
Malware and unwanted software are undesirable applications that perform annoying, disruptive, or harmful actions on affected machines. Some of these undesirable applications can replicate and spread from one machine to another. Others are able to receive commands from remote attackers and perform activities associated with cyber attacks.

A malware is considered active if it is found running on the machine or it already has persistence mechanisms in place. Active malware detections are assigned higher severity ratings.

Because this malware was active, take precautionary measures and check for residual signs of infection.

interpretation.scope: official graph witness, not a proof of causality, actor identity or autonomous planning
